data.narrative:
Atom Bodies is a Series A-stage biotech company that has raised $142.2M to date. The valuation universe comprises 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private comparables including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three triangulation methods examined, only stage-progression proved applicable. This method uses the $142M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A progression to subsequent rounds, yielding $284M. Peer-median analysis was not feasible due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables within the Biotech & Health sector—only 1 adjacent-stage peer met filter criteria, below the minimum threshold of 3. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples could not be applied because target revenue is not disclosed; while the sector median P/S across the 3 public tickers stands at 9.2x, this metric is not actionable without the target's revenue figure.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $242M to $327M, with a median point estimate of $284M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty. The valuation is sensitive to (1) accuracy of the stage-progression multiplier, which may not reflect Atom Bodies' specific risk profile or capital efficiency, and (2) the absence of peer-relative anchoring, which would otherwise validate or adjust the range. Additional disclosure of revenue or a tighter comparable set would strengthen confidence in this range.
